measurements.check ratio and verdict: harness pile_ratios: 20-step adversary PGD KL on 256 Pile rows, state / same-job W0 at seed 0. base_verdict = faith_score.state_verdict(pile, 1.0, w0, p_min=0.0): each of the PGD and stochastic ratios against its own same-job W0 floor; pass at or below 1.5 / (1 + f), fail at or above 1.5 (1 + f), both inclusive, any fail is fail, any between is inconclusive. Absolute lines from this job's floor. P(target) is taken out: with nothing to learn the P gate would read 'below P 0.9' for every arm. NaN or infinite ratio: 'invalid'. Blind to: one adversary start, 20 steps, 256 rows, a pass is a lower bound. Positive control: E42 A1's M0 25.99 on this card; E39's random move at damage 0.24 16.5, 27.2 (H100). Noise floor: W0's ratio moves 0.21 between adversary seeds on the L40, so readings are class calls, not differences
measurements.stochastic, CI-masked, Delta-out ratios: pile_ratios stochastic_kl, ci_masked_kl, unmasked_kl, same-job W0 seed 0, saved per read. Reported, not scored. Noise: stochastic floor 0.002, CI-masked and Delta-out deterministic for a fixed state. Blind to the adversary
measurements.unmasked KL to W0 (kl_w0): teacher.heldout_gap of the state's target model against W0, arm A's weighting (trigger + mean elsewhere) on the task's held-out windows, merged weights. n4: row_copy.read_state's mean KL over every position, on lowercase held-out rows (kl_w0_lowercase) and plain rows (damage). Absolute, nats. Hook-path training floor 0.0005-0.0007. Blind to text outside those windows
measurements.size: harness rel_norm_max: the largest ||delta-W|| / ||W0|| over the 24 matrices. Batch-order spread of the emoticon arm-A student 0.01842 against 0.01843 (E34 seed 0, Amendment 4 seed 1): under 1%. Blind to direction: same size does not mean the same move; to the other 23 matrices
measurements.P(target): arms.heldout_of at the trigger, held-out windows; n1, n2, n3, n5 only. n4's task has no single target: gain (mean log-probability on lowercase held-out rows, state - W0) instead
measurements.return fraction (n1, n2): 1 - size at step 1000 / size at step 0, both harness size of the same run, so relative. Negative if it grew. Size at start 0 or not finite: None (unscorable). 'returned' at or above 0.76, inclusive. The 0.76 is the plan's figure, from E34 C3, which is a recovery of squared (dU, dV) offsets (1 - sum ||off - target||^2 / sum ||target||^2); this one is linear in size and gauge-free. A size-based 0.76 is the harder bar: squared recovery 0.76 is a linear fall of about 0.51 at the same place. Positive control: none in-job can return by construction; 1.0 at W0 and 0 for a state that did not move bound it. Blind to direction and to the place it ends if not W0
measurements.chosen checkpoint (n3a): nearest_checkpoint: of steps 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, the one with the smallest absolute difference between its size and the same-job T1000's size; a tie goes to the earlier step; non-finite sizes are left out. No finite size, or a target not a positive number: None, and n3b refuses. Fixed before n3a runs. If no checkpoint is near, the rule still picks; the miss is in the note
measurements.size class (n3b): r = null student's size at step 1000 / same-job real student's at step 1000 (same step count). Relative: E41's 0.018 is not used. r >= 0.75 'about' (comparable; no upper cap: r above 1 is expected from the real student's loud start, Adam's memory shrinking its later steps, code review finding 2); r <= 0.50 'well under'; between 'partly'. Both ends inclusive. Real size 0 or a NaN: 'unscorable'. 0.75: T10, a third of T1000's size at P 0.999, gives a student 0.77 of T1000's. Batch-order noise under 1%. Blind to direction, which is why it cannot decide alone
measurements.direction (n3b): finetune.cosines 'all': the weight changes over all 24 matrices concatenated, at step 1000. null_real = null student against the real student, batch order 0 both; control = real student against the real student at batch order 1, same job (positive control; E34 Amendment 5 read 0.913 on task text); null_teacher = null student against its own teacher's delta-W; real_teacher = real student against T1000's delta-W (log: 0.05-0.44 across tasks). Noise floor: about 2e-4 for random directions. Class: non-finite 'unscorable'; control below 0.2 'no power' (it would put the shared line under the none line); null_real >= 0.5 x control 'shared'; null_real < 0.1, absolute, 'none' (negatives included); else 'some'. Ties inclusive on 'shared'. Absolute against the control, relative to it for 'shared'. Blind to: both students share batch order 0, so a shared cosine may be the shared batches, which leans toward 'the recipe', the conservative side; size-weighted: large matrices dominate
measurements.the recipe (n3b): size class x direction, every pair has a row. well under + anything: 'not the recipe'. about + shared: 'the recipe'. about + some, partly + shared, partly + some: 'partly'. about + none, partly + none: 'a walk elsewhere' (a move that happens anyway, not the real student's move). unscorable size, or about or partly with direction unscorable or no power: 'unscorable'. follows_null_teacher = null_teacher >= real_teacher, reported: whether the null student is copying its teacher at least as much as the real one copies T1000

predictions.rule: gap = gap_class(kl_w0 at 0, kl_w0 at 1000, line 0.002 nats, absolute: about 3 x the largest hook-floor reading, H100): non-finite 'invalid'; start at or under the line 'no power' (stopped at read 0, so reached only by a fault); end at or under it 'closed'; end under start 'partly'; else 'not closed'. Verdict at 1000 by base_verdict. outcome: verdict fail -> 'fails'; invalid or gap invalid or no power -> 'unscorable'; gap other than 'closed' -> 'fails, gap not closed'; else pass -> 'holds', inconclusive -> 'inconclusive'. Return fraction reported, classed at 0.76, not in the outcome: the plan gives it no expected value here. Decision-tree card: verdict fail only; 'fails, gap not closed' has its own row, no card (plan Tree)
predictions.lean: outcome 'fails, gap not closed', medium: a small gap gives Adam a walk, so size 0.028-0.039 and the gap partly or not closed. Verdict pass, medium-low, lowered from high: the references at that end size disagree (random moves 1.03, 1.07; E37's trained state 2.2 on other text), and 'high' rested on the start's size. Not returned, high
predictions.blind_to: one random direction, one batch order, one adversary start; the start has this size but little damage, so it does not test a state as far off in function as a trained one (n2 does)
predictions.positive_control: the check: M0 on this card, 25.99. The gap: n2's start, about 5 nats, read the same way

predictions.rule: gap_class with line = 0.05 x kl_w0 at 0 (relative); kl_w0 at 0 of 0 is stopped at read 0. p_back: P(target) at 1000 at or under 0.04, absolute, ten times W0's, because 5% of KL(W0 || state) allows P about 0.25; NaN None. Return fraction at 1000, 'returned' at or above 0.76. Verdict at 1000. outcome: verdict fail -> 'fails'; invalid, gap unscorable, p_back None or return None -> 'unscorable'; gap other than 'closed', P not back or not returned -> 'fails'; pass -> 'holds'; inconclusive -> 'inconclusive'. Decision-tree card: verdict fail, not returned, or P not back. Score also carries the T1000 student's own verdict and check on this card
predictions.lean: verdict pass, medium-high. Gap closed and P back, medium. Not returned, medium-low, which differs from the plan's expected value: E41's sizes barely follow the teacher, so part of the move is Adam's walk, which a return does not undo, and the walk continues on the way back; I lean to a fraction of 0.2-0.6. That would make the outcome 'fails' on the return part alone and trigger the card
predictions.blind_to: one state, one batch order; fresh Adam state; size says how far from W0, not by which path; 1,000 steps at the rate that took 1,000 steps to get out
predictions.positive_control: W0's start would read fraction None and kl 0 by construction; T1000 student's own read at step 0 reproduces E41's

predictions.rule: size, kl_w0, damage, P(target) of the null fine-tune at 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000, logged and saved; no harness; chosen checkpoint by nearest_checkpoint. Nothing scored

predictions.rule: class by 'the recipe (n3b)' in measurements. Verdict at 1000. outcome: verdict fail -> 'fails'; invalid or unscorable -> 'unscorable'; class 'the recipe' or 'partly' -> 'fails'; class 'not the recipe' or 'a walk elsewhere' with pass -> 'holds', with inconclusive -> 'inconclusive'. Decision-tree card: class 'the recipe' or verdict fail. 'partly' goes to the user as a surprise, no automatic card. Damage reported, not in the rule. Score also carries the real student's verdict and check
predictions.lean: class 'a walk elsewhere', medium-low: size comparable or above the real student's (r 1-1.8 from the loud start alone), direction under 0.1 since nothing but batch order is shared. Verdict pass, medium. Corrects the first filing's T1 argument: T1's gap at W0 is 4.48 nats, so T1 is a small update with a large gap, no evidence on small gaps

predictions.rule: at E39's scored state (Adam 1e-5 step 1000; SGD 0.03 step 100; SGD's step 1000 reported): base_verdict of the self-label state. pass 'near base'; inconclusive 'inconclusive'; invalid 'unscorable'. fail with the PGD ratio not failing: 'fails on the stochastic ratio'. fail on PGD: share = (self check - 1) / (same-job true-label check - 1); true check at or under 1 or not finite: 'fails, no reference'; share at or above 0.5: 'fails, about the true labels'; else 'fails, under the true labels'. n4_adam only: true-label verdict not 'fail' -> class and outcome 'no reference' for a self-label state not failing, 'fails, no reference' for one failing: a pass there has no power. E39's 7.24 itself is not read against: another card. Decision-tree card: verdict fail. SGD's true-label state may read inconclusive on this card (H100 1.28 against 1.24), its filed exemption: SGD has no 'no reference' rule
predictions.lean: Adam 'near base', medium-low: a random move of this size reads about 1, and Adam's size here should stay under 0.054; against it, damage drives the check and 512-token rows give much more text. SGD 'near base', medium-high: clipped gradients with no mean give a small move

predictions.rule: base_verdict at step 1000 on the component path. outcome: fail -> 'fails'; invalid -> 'unscorable'; inconclusive -> 'inconclusive'; pass -> 'holds'.
